What We Do

Crafted services for every outdoor vision

Request a service

Garden Design

Custom planting plans and landscape layouts tailored to your soil, climate, and lifestyle — from cottage gardens to sleek modern courtyards.

Lawn Care & Maintenance

Weekly mowing, edging, aeration, and overseeding programs that keep your lawn dense, green, and weed-free through every season.

Hardscaping & Patios

Stone patios, retaining walls, walkways, and fire pit areas built to last — materials sourced locally where possible.

Outdoor Lighting

Low-voltage LED landscape lighting for security, ambiance, and highlighting the best features of your property after dark.

Tree & Shrub Pruning

Expert pruning that promotes healthy growth, improves form, and prevents property damage — done by ISA-certified arborists.

Irrigation Systems

Smart zone-based irrigation design, installation, and seasonal start-up/winterization to protect your investment and conserve water.

14 Years in Business

Our Story

A family craft, carried forward

GreatScapes Outdoor Service started with a single family's backyard and a belief that outdoor spaces should feel as considered as the home inside. Today, our crew of 18 brings that same attention to properties across the region — from weekend maintenance visits to complete landscape transformations that span months.

We hire for patience, curiosity, and real horticultural knowledge. Every project lead has at least a decade of hands-on experience. We don't subcontract; the crew you meet on day one is the crew that sees the job through.

  • Fully licensed & insured, serving the greater metro area
  • ISA Certified Arborists on staff
  • Sustainable practices — native plants, organic fertilizers
  • Transparent pricing, no hidden fees
  • 2-year workmanship guarantee on all installations

How It Works

From first call to finished garden

1

Free Site Visit

We walk your property together, listen to your goals, and assess soil, drainage, and sun patterns before suggesting anything.

2

Design Proposal

You receive a detailed plan with plant selections, materials, layout sketches, and a transparent line-item estimate — no surprises.

3

Expert Installation

Our crew handles every step on schedule, keeping your property clean and communicating progress throughout the project.

4

Ongoing Care

Optional maintenance programs keep everything thriving year-round — and we're always a call away if something needs attention.
